name: Stack/breeching dampers, bypass dampers and sealing systems for HRSG simple-cycle operation
description: Diverter/bypass damper systems route gas-turbine exhaust either to the bypass stack (simple cycle, HRSG offline) or through the HRSG (combined cycle), with mechanically interlocked isolation and seal-air systems so personnel can enter the isolated HRSG while the turbine runs. Stack dampers slow HRSG cooling between starts, prevent rain ingress and provide overpressure relief. Primary source: https://www.forneycorp.com/articles/hrsg-bypass-dampers

specifications.unit: degrees: open damper locked >80 degrees while mating damper closes >10 degrees
specifications.basis: Forney article; mechanical interlock requires one damper at least 80% open so turbine exhaust cannot be fully blocked

specifications.metric: Forney seal-air fans and allowable entry temperature
specifications.unit: fans at 200% capacity; seal-air curtain designed to maintain temperatures below 140 F (OSHA confined-space requirement) for HRSG entry
specifications.basis: Forney article; truss blade cavity forms air-seal plenum, flexible seal packs at blade tips

specifications.metric: Carbon packing temperature limit and shaft material
specifications.unit: degrees C (753 F) oxidising temperature limit for carbon components; 17-4PH stainless shaft
specifications.basis: Forney article; purged lantern ring prevents exposure to corrosion and temperature above the oxidising limit

specifications.value: two BiPlane Dampers - one on HRSG inlet, one isolating the stack
mechanical interlock prevents both dampers closing at the same time; allows both open
dual set of seals; seal air system interlocked if pressure falls indicating a leak

specifications.basis: Printed under Features & Benefits; no numeric performance figures printed
specifications.value: soft start flow distribution; control capability; reduced time to open; eliminates guillotine damper; smaller actuators

specifications.basis: "Forney utilizes two BiPlane Dampers for superior isolation and control. One damper on the inlet to the HRSG and the other damper isolating the stack"
"The two BiPlane Dampers allow for soft start and better control capabilities with an independent actuator on each damper"

"Mechanical interlock – Prevents both Dampers from closing at the same time – Allows both to be open at the same time"; "Dual set of seals – two layers of protection"; "Seal air system – interlocked if pressure falls indicating a leak"
"Better: Soft start flow distribution, Control capability, Safety, Sealing performance; Faster: Reduced time to open; Cheaper: Eliminate the need for the Guillotine Damper, Smaller actuators"
